# Next.js 15 Starter Repository

> Production-grade Next.js 15 starter repository built with Tailwind CSS v4, ESLint 9 Flat Config, TypeScript, and Husky automation.

## Core Architecture & Conventions

- [Architecture Overview](https://yourdomain.com/docs/architecture): App Router layout, directory structure, route groups, and component organization.
- [Code & Linting Standards](https://yourdomain.com/docs/standards): ESLint 9 Flat Config (`eslint.config.mjs`), Prettier configuration, and TypeScript guidelines.
- [Git Hooks & Workflow](https://yourdomain.com/docs/git-workflow): Husky v9 pre-commit verification, lint-staged automation, and Conventional Commit message rules.

## Tech Stack & Tooling

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, React 19)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4 (`@tailwindcss/postcss`, CSS variables, `@theme` directive)
- **Linting & Formatting**: Native ESLint v9 Flat Config, Prettier
- **Git Hygiene**: Husky v9, `lint-staged`, Commitlint (Conventional Commits)
- **Theme Management**: `next-themes` with hydration protection
- **Smooth Scroll**: Lenis (scoped to marketing route groups)

## Full Context

- [llms-full.txt](https://yourdomain.com/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated documentation and configuration guide for direct LLM ingestion.

## Discovery & Indexing

- [Sitemap](https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml): Primary XML index for search engines and crawlers.
- [Robots File](https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt): Crawler rules for AI and search bots.
